controls.title: Policy Area 1 - Information Exchange Agreements
controls.description: Information exchange agreements shall be in place between agencies sharing Criminal Justice Information.

controls.title: Policy Area 2 - Security Awareness Training
controls.description: Basic security awareness training shall be required within six months of initial assignment, and biennially thereafter.

controls.title: Policy Area 3 - Incident Response
controls.description: The agency shall establish operational incident handling procedures, reporting structure, and response capabilities.

controls.title: Policy Area 4 - Auditing and Accountability
controls.description: Agencies shall implement audit and accountability controls to provide for the creation, protection, and retention of information system audit records.

controls.title: Auditable Events
controls.description: The information system shall generate audit records for defined events including successful/unsuccessful logon attempts, file accesses, and account management.

controls.title: Content of Audit Records
controls.description: The information system shall produce audit records that contain sufficient information to establish what events occurred, the sources, and outcomes.

controls.title: Audit Monitoring, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.description: The agency shall designate an individual or position to review/analyze information system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity.

controls.title: Time Stamps
controls.description: The information system shall use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.description: The information system shall protect audit information and audit tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

controls.title: Audit Record Retention
controls.description: The agency shall retain audit records for at least one year.

controls.title: Policy Area 5 - Access Control
controls.description: Access control provides the planning and implementation of mechanisms to restrict reading, writing, processing, and transmission of CJIS information.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: The agency shall manage information system accounts, including establishing, activating, modifying, reviewing, disabling, and removing accounts.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: The information system shall enforce assigned authorizations for controlling access to the system and contained information.

controls.title: Unsuccessful Login Attempts
controls.description: The system shall enforce a limit of no more than 5 consecutive invalid access attempts by a user.

controls.title: System Use Notification
controls.description: The information system shall display an approved system use notification message before granting access.

controls.title: Session Lock
controls.description: The information system shall prevent further access to the system by initiating a session lock after a maximum of 30 minutes of inactivity.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: The agency shall authorize, monitor, and control all methods of remote access to the information system.

controls.title: Personally Owned Information Systems
controls.description: A personally owned information system shall not be authorized to access, process, store, or transmit CJI unless approved agency policies and procedures are in place.

controls.title: Policy Area 6 - Identification and Authentication
controls.description: The information system shall uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users or processes acting on behalf of organizational users.

controls.title: Use of Standard Authentication
controls.description: Authentication shall include the use of a password, token, biometric, or other approved mechanism at the AAL2 level.

controls.title: Advanced Authentication
controls.description: Advanced authentication shall be required for all users accessing CJI remotely or from a network that is not a physically secure location.

controls.title: Policy Area 7 - Configuration Management
controls.description: The agency shall establish mandatory configuration requirements and manage changes to information systems.

controls.title: Policy Area 8 - Media Protection
controls.description: The agency shall restrict access to system media containing CJI to authorized individuals and shall sanitize or destroy system media before disposal or release.

controls.title: Policy Area 9 - Physical Protection
controls.description: The agency shall protect the physical facility and support infrastructure for information systems containing CJI.

controls.title: Policy Area 10 - Systems and Communications Protection and Information Integrity
controls.description: The agency shall monitor, control, and protect communications at external and key internal boundaries, and employ architectural designs and software development techniques to protect system integrity.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.description: The information system shall enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of CJI within the system and between interconnected systems.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: The information system shall monitor and control communications at the external boundary and at key internal boundaries.

controls.title: Encryption
controls.description: The agency shall ensure encryption is used for CJI in transit and at rest using FIPS 140-2 certified or NSA-approved cryptographic modules.

controls.title: Intrusion Detection Tools and Techniques
controls.description: The agency shall implement network-based and/or host-based intrusion detection tools.

controls.title: Patch Management
controls.description: The agency shall identify, report, and correct information system flaws in a timely manner.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: The agency shall implement malicious code protection mechanisms at information system entry and exit points.

controls.title: Spam and Spyware Protection
controls.description: The agency shall implement spam and spyware protection.

controls.title: Personal Firewall
controls.description: A personal firewall shall be employed on all devices that access CJI remotely.

controls.title: Policy Area 11 - Formal Audits
controls.description: The agency shall perform a comprehensive audit at a minimum of every three years.

controls.title: Policy Area 12 - Personnel Security
controls.description: All personnel who have unescorted access to unencrypted CJI shall have a fingerprint-based record check.

controls.title: Policy Area 13 - Mobile Devices
controls.description: The agency shall implement controls on mobile devices used to access, store, process or transmit CJI.
